baseline.description: VCS baseline captured in INIT: branch, commit, status/diff summary.

scope.description: User-chosen cleanup scope from the upfront gate: mode (full_repository | uncommitted | recent_commits | paths | audit_only), plus commit_count / since / paths when applicable. Everything outside this scope is frozen for the whole run.

protected_paths.description: Paths modified before RepoMeld started or otherwise protected. Mutation workers must never touch them.

category.description: Finding category, using the finding.schema.json vocabulary.

action.description: Preserved knowledge is not an action; escalations live in the escalations array. Add actions introduce one complete new comment unit; reason must cite the comment-library template id and the code facts each slot was filled from.

owner.description: Write owner; must be the id of a shard in shards[].

proposed_change.description: Intended replacement text or transformation summary for rewrite actions.

preservation_rationale.description: Required when this action retains or moves durable engineering knowledge.

reference_evidence.description: Required for delete and relocate actions.
